financials_interim.notes: Company (standalone) P&L: 'Tax (expense)/Reversed' line is a tax CREDIT of 20,440 (PBT 15,809 -> PAT 36,249), so tax_expense is stored as -20,440 to keep profit_before_tax - tax_expense = profit_after_tax. No NCI, no discontinued operations at Company level. EPS 0.13 = 36,249,000/273,000,000, ties cleanly.

Group P&L presents continuing operations through to PBT/tax (operating_profit=Results from operating activities 1,116,057; PBT=722,858; tax=219,074; PAT-continuing=503,784), but Lanka Swisstek (Pvt) Ltd (India ops, disposal group, 51%-owned via Lanka Tiles) and Valley View Ceramics LLC (US, wind-up) are presented as discontinued operations with a combined loss after tax of Rs 6,921k. profit_after_tax stored here (496,863) is the TOTAL bottom line 'Profit/(Loss) for the period' including discontinued ops, matching the Statement of Changes in Equity roll-forward (Balance 1 Apr 2026 22,320,085+NCI 7,430,056 -> Balance 30 Jun 2026 22,628,071+NCI 7,591,380, driven by net profit 496,863). minority_interest=208,784 is NCI's share of the total 496,863, also per the equity statement. EPS: filing's reported Basic EPS (1.82) does NOT tie to profit attributable to parent (288,079/273,000,000=1.06) -- it ties exactly to TOTAL profit for the period including NCI (496,863,000/273,000,000=1.820), and the same pattern holds for the prior-year comparative (112,976,000/273,000,000=0.41) and for the continuing-operations-only EPS line (1.85 = 503,784,000/273,000,000; 0.79 = 216,602,000/273,000,000). This is an unusual EPS convention (using total Group profit incl. NCI rather than PATMI) but the arithmetic is unambiguous and consistent across both periods and both EPS lines, so the disclosed 1.82 / 0.41 figures are stored as-is. Balance sheet identity ties exactly (total assets = total liabilities + equity, incl. assets/liabilities held for sale) so no column-swap ambiguity was found in this filing. total_liabilities = non-current + current + liabilities associated with assets held for sale.

interim_updates.note_text: Lanka Walltiles PLC (Group) grew revenue 17% YoY to Rs 10,978mn for Q1 FY2026/27 (quarter ended 30 June 2026), with gross margin expanding from 24.2% to 28.7% and gross profit up 39% to Rs 3,148mn. All three reporting segments grew: Tiles & associated items revenue rose from Rs 4,462mn to Rs 5,646mn (+26.5%) and its segment PBT swung from a near-breakeven Rs 2.3mn to Rs 328.5mn -- the single largest driver of the Group's profit improvement, reflecting the turnaround at subsidiary Lanka Tiles PLC (68.22%-owned, entered separately this session as TILE) which itself reported a strong Q1. Aluminium Products PBT rose from Rs 85.9mn to Rs 168.5mn (+96%) on revenue growth from Rs 2,622mn to Rs 2,837mn (+8.2%), and Packing materials PBT rose from Rs 205.6mn to Rs 225.9mn (+9.8%) on revenue growth from Rs 2,390mn to Rs 2,582mn (+8.4%). Group finance costs fell slightly (Rs 434,958k to Rs 420,868k, -3%) despite the working-capital-driven increase in interest-bearing debt, while finance income rose 60% to Rs 27,643k -- a modest net tailwind of about Rs 24mn. Discontinued operations (Valley View Ceramics LLC, being wound up in the US, and Lanka Swisstek (Pvt) Ltd, a 51%-owned India disposal group held via Lanka Tiles) narrowed their combined loss from Rs 103.6mn to Rs 6.9mn YoY, adding roughly Rs 96.7mn to the period-on-period profit swing. Net profit attributable to non-controlling interests jumped from Rs 47,962k to Rs 208,784k, reflecting NCI's much larger share of the improved Tiles-segment profit (Lanka Tiles PLC carries a ~32% external NCI stake).
interim_updates.gaps_note: No QoQ comparison possible: no quarter closer to this one has been collected for LWL -- this is the first financial_statements entry for this symbol. Company-level (standalone) balance sheet YoY comparison is also unavailable: the filing's Statement of Financial Position only gives a prior-FYE comparative (31 March 2026, audited), not a 30 June 2025 balance sheet, so only P&L items have a true same-quarter-prior-year comparison.
interim_updates.takeaway: Headline PAT growth (+340% YoY) is driven almost entirely by a turnaround at the Tiles segment (effectively Lanka Tiles PLC) from near-breakeven to Rs 328.5mn PBT, plus a Rs 96.7mn narrowing of discontinued-operations losses -- both one-off-flavoured swings rather than steady-state margin expansion, so the 340% growth rate should not be extrapolated forward. Note also that the Group's own reported EPS (Rs 1.82) is calculated on TOTAL profit including the now much-larger NCI share, not on profit attributable to parent shareholders (which would give Rs 1.06/share) -- worth flagging if EPS is used for valuation.

operational_highlights: Group revenue Rs 10,978mn, +17% YoY; gross margin expanded from 24.2% to 28.7%
Tiles & associated items segment PBT swung from Rs 2.3mn to Rs 328.5mn on revenue up 26.5% to Rs 5,646mn
Aluminium Products segment PBT +96% to Rs 168.5mn on revenue +8.2% to Rs 2,837mn
Packing materials segment PBT +9.8% to Rs 225.9mn on revenue +8.4% to Rs 2,582mn
Discontinued operations (Valley View Ceramics LLC wind-up + Lanka Swisstek Pvt Ltd India disposal group) loss narrowed from Rs 103.6mn to Rs 6.9mn YoY
Group operating cash flow was negative Rs 1,217mn (vs +Rs 323mn prior year), driven by a Rs 1,262mn inventory build during the quarter
key_drivers: Tiles & associated items segment (Lanka Tiles PLC, 68.22%-owned) -- PBT swing from Rs 2.3mn to Rs 328.5mn is the dominant driver of Group profit growth
Discontinued operations (Valley View Ceramics LLC US wind-up; Lanka Swisstek Pvt Ltd India disposal group, 51%-owned) -- combined loss narrowed by Rs 96.7mn YoY
Non-controlling interest -- NCI's profit share rose from Rs 48mn to Rs 209mn as the Tiles segment (which carries the largest external NCI) drove most of the Group's improvement
